<iframe id='iframe_objectif' src="" width="100%" height="800px"></iframe>

<script>
function escapeSingleQuote(str) {
    return str.replace(/'/g, "''");
}

$(document).ready(function() {
    // Retrieve values and escape single quotes
    const latestDiplome = escapeSingleQuote(document.getElementById('latestDiplome').value);
    const latestNiveau = escapeSingleQuote(document.getElementById('latestNiveau').value);
    const NatureBac = escapeSingleQuote(document.getElementById('NatureBac').value);

    // Construct the URL with encoded parameters
    const iframeSrc = `/jw/web/userview/appcenter/home/_/liste_des_formations?embed=true&latestDiplome=${encodeURIComponent(latestDiplome)}&latestNiveau=${encodeURIComponent(latestNiveau)}&NatureBac=${encodeURIComponent(NatureBac)}`;

    // Set the src attribute of the iframe
    document.getElementById('iframe_objectif').src = iframeSrc;
});

</script>

<style>
#iframe_objectif {
    border: none;
    background: white !important;
}
</style>
